title: common (library chart) values
description: Library chart -- a consumer chart's values are validated against this schema. The library itself only ships an empty `global: {}`.

name.description: Application name (label app.kubernetes.io/name). See docs/values-reference.md for the full resolution order.

profile.description: Selects a set of library defaults (probe paths, podMonitor metricRelabelings, envFrom phantom names). Default `generic`. Set `rails` to preserve v1.3.1 behavior. Security context is a separate axis — see `security`.

security.description: Container/pod securityContext posture, independent of `profile`. `minimal` (default): baseline container hardening — allowPrivilegeEscalation:false, capabilities drop-ALL, pod seccompProfile RuntimeDefault (runAsNonRoot and readOnlyRootFilesystem stay opt-in). `generic`: adds runAsNonRoot and readOnlyRootFilesystem on top of the minimal baseline. Overridable per-scope via `global.securityContext` and `<cmp>.securityContext`.

deployTool.description: Which tool consumes the rendered manifests. Selects the dialect of ordering and lifecycle metadata the chart emits. Default: werf when werf service values are present, otherwise generic. ArgoCD cannot be auto-detected and must be set explicitly. See docs/values-reference.md#deploy-tool-dialect.

secretStore.description: Default secretStoreRef name for all ExternalSecrets rendered by chart.extsecret. Overridable per secret via secrets.<name>.secretStore. No default — when unset, every secret must declare its own store.

configWeight.description: Ordering weight for ConfigMaps and native Secrets. Emitted as werf.io/weight under deployTool: werf and argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave under deployTool: argocd. Default -1. Falls back to the legacy werf.configWeight.

secretWeight.description: Ordering weight for ExternalSecrets. Emitted as werf.io/weight under deployTool: werf and argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave under deployTool: argocd. Default -1. Falls back to the legacy werf.secretWeight.

replicasOnCreationAnnotation.description: Annotation key written with the initial replica count when the component has scaling.min but no explicit replicas. Empty disables. Defaults to werf.io/replicas-on-creation when werf annotations are enabled.

probe.description: Chart-wide probe field overrides. Slots between the profile default and the per-component value. See docs/values-reference.md#probes.

envFrom.description: Chart-wide envFrom projections appended before per-component entries. configs -> configMapRef, secrets -> secretRef.

emitEnvironmentLabel.description: Emit the non-standard helm.sh/environment label on all rendered resources. Default true; v3.0 will flip to false.

checksumAnnotations.description: Emit a checksum/config pod annotation on Deployment/StatefulSet/DaemonSet so ConfigMap/Secret content changes trigger a rollout. Default false under deployTool generic/werf, true under deployTool argocd, where no helm upgrade event exists and this hash is the only rollout trigger. Per-component override: <cmp>.rollOnConfigChange. Deliberately excludes ExternalSecret-delivered material, so ESO rotation does not roll pods.

prometheusEndpoint.description: Default serverAddress for KEDA ScaledObject Prometheus triggers. Required at render time when any trigger has type: prometheus and no explicit serverAddress.

monitoring.description: Observability knobs. releaseLabel injects release: <value> onto every ServiceMonitor / PodMonitor / PrometheusRule for kube-prometheus-stack discovery.

externalSecrets.description: ExternalSecret behavior knobs. forceSync stamps a force-sync annotation so ESO re-reconciles. Default true under deployTool generic/werf (per-render timestamp) and false under deployTool argocd, where a per-render value is permanent drift. Setting it true under argocd yields a stable per-revision value, never a timestamp.

preInstallEnvironments.description: Environments where ConfigMaps/ExternalSecrets are emitted as pre-install,pre-upgrade Helm hooks. Default: [] (no hooks). Ignored under deployTool: argocd, where the ordering intent is emitted as argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave instead — ArgoCD converts Helm hooks to PreSync hooks, which removes the object from the Application's desired state and recreates it on every sync.

annotations.description: Explicit override for emitting werf.io/* annotations. When unset, defaults to true if both werf.name and werf.env are present.

legacySelectorLabels.description: Include `version` and `extraLabels` in `common.labels.matchLabels`. Use only when migrating a chart whose pre-1.3 release stored those labels in selectors -- changing selector contents on existing Deployments/StatefulSets is not allowed by Kubernetes.

instanceInSelector.description: Include app.kubernetes.io/instance in every generated selector. Default true. NEW INSTALLS ONLY: selectors are immutable, so flipping this on a live workload requires delete/recreate (--cascade=orphan for StatefulSets). Set false under ArgoCD when the Application name may diverge from the Helm release name, and supply global.selectorLabels as a replacement discriminator.

envValues.description: Render <cmp>.env values, ConfigMap data, native Secret stringData and KEDA prometheus queries through Helm `tpl`. Default true under deployTool generic/werf, false under deployTool argocd, where consumer-authored non-deterministic template text re-renders on every reconcile. Set false to emit values verbatim (closes the templating-injection surface for untrusted multi-tenant values). Per-component override: <cmp>.envRaw: true. v3.0 will flip the default to false everywhere.

allowClusterlessLookups.description: Allow lookup-dependent and random helpers to render under deployTool: argocd. Default false, because ArgoCD's repo-server has no cluster access: lookup returns empty, so these helpers emit regenerated or empty values that ArgoCD then applies over live Secret/ConfigMap data.

retain.description: Protect standalone PVCs from deletion. Default false. Emits helm.sh/resource-policy: keep, plus argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: Prune=false under deployTool: argocd, where resource-policy is inert and an auto-sync prune destroys the claim and its data within one reconcile.

annotations.description: Annotations merged into workloads (Deployment/StatefulSet/DaemonSet/Job/CronJob), ConfigMap, Secret, ExternalSecret, Service, ServiceAccount, PDB, PVC, PodMonitor, NetworkPolicy, RBAC, PriorityClass, ScaledObject and TriggerAuthentication. A resource's own annotations win. Use for chart-wide argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options or ownership metadata. NOT applied to HPA, VPA, HTTPRoute, PrometheusRule or ServiceMonitor (set those per-resource), nor to Ingress (use global.ingress.annotations).

extraLabels.description: Labels merged into common.labels on every resource. NOT added to selectors — see global.selectorLabels for that.

selectorLabels.description: Labels added to BOTH common.labels and every generated selector. Use as a stable discriminator when global.compat.instanceInSelector is false. Immutable in practice — changing these on a live workload requires delete/recreate.

werf.description: Legacy werf-style values. Supported as fallback for name/env/image but no longer required.

images.description: Per-component image overrides keyed by component name (DNS or values-key form).

configs.description: Top-level extra ConfigMaps. Each entry produces a ConfigMap.

annotations.description: Extra annotations merged after the chart defaults (e.g. argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave).
Extra annotations merged after the chart defaults (e.g. argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave).

properties.description: Remote fields to fetch. A list uses each field name as the Secret key; a map is <secretKey>: <remoteProperty>, for stores whose field names differ from the keys the workload expects.

triggerAuthentications.description: KEDA TriggerAuthentication entries (chart.triggerauth). Set .cluster: true for ClusterTriggerAuthentication.

networkPolicies.description: Top-level freeform NetworkPolicy entries (chart.networkpolicy). Per-component networkPolicy: lives under <component>.

rbac.description: Top-level freeform RBAC entries (chart.rbac). Per-component .rbac / .rbacCluster live under <component>.

$comment: Component keys (web, worker, ...) are consumer-named and intentionally not schema-validated here. A patternProperties over all keys also matched reserved structural keys (global, app, werf, images, configs, secrets, ...) and spuriously forced them through the component schema (e.g. rejecting global.replicas). jobs/cronjobs entries are validated via $ref:#/$defs/component where the shape is known.

annotations.description: Annotation map. metadata.annotations is map[string]string, so non-string values are coerced to strings at render time. Quoting numeric values (e.g. argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "-1") is still recommended.

profile.description: Per-component profile override (v2.1+). Resolution chain: <cmp>.profile -> global.profile -> 'generic'. Lets mixed-tech charts pick a different profile per workload.

kind.description: scaleTargetRef.kind. Defaults to Deployment. For StatefulSet (or any non-Deployment) workloads you MUST set this explicitly — the library cannot infer the workload kind.

apiVersion.description: scaleTargetRef.apiVersion. Defaults to apps/v1. Override when targeting a CRD or a non-apps/v1 workload.

maxReplicas.description: Required. Upper replica bound — the chart fails to render without it.

targetName.description: scaleTargetRef.name override (defaults to the component name).

httpRoute.description: Gateway API HTTPRoute (chart.httproute): parentRefs, hostnames, rules, port. backendRefs default to the component's Service.

jobAnnotations.description: For cronjobs.<name>: annotations applied to spec.jobTemplate.metadata, i.e. to each spawned Job rather than to the CronJob itself.

rollOnConfigChange.description: Emit a checksum/config pod annotation so ConfigMap/Secret changes roll this workload. Default false.

hook.description: For jobs.<name> under deployTool: argocd, emit argocd.argoproj.io/hook with this phase plus hook-delete-policy: BeforeHookCreation, so the Job re-runs each sync instead of failing on Job spec immutability. Ignored under other deploy tools.
